summary: Under normal market circumstances, the fund will maintain at least 80% exposure to financial instruments that provide two times leveraged exposure to the calendar quarter performance of the SPDR® S&P 500® ETF Trust. The manager will enter into one or more swaps with major global financial institutions whereby the fund and the global financial institution will agree to exchange the return earned or realized on the SPDR® S&P 500® ETF Trust. The fund is non-diversified.
